name: Berggasthof Kandleralm
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Berggasthof Kandleralm in Brixen im Thale**

Nestled in the heart of the **Tiroler Alps**, **Berggasthof Kandleralm** invites you to experience authentic alpine hospitality in the picturesque village of **Brixen im Thale**. Surrounded by breathtaking mountain scenery, this cozy mountain inn offers a perfect retreat for nature lovers, hikers, and families alike.

Indulge in traditional **Tiroler** cuisine, where every dish is crafted with local ingredients. Savor hearty classics like **Kaiserschmarrn**, creamy **Käsespätzle**, or a rich **Tiroler Gröstl**, all paired with crisp **Tiroler beer** or smooth **Apfelstrudel** for dessert.

After a day of exploring the stunning trails of the **Kitzbühel Alps**, relax in our rustic yet welcoming atmosphere. Whether you're enjoying a warm **Glühwein** by the fireplace or unwinding with a good book on the sun-drenched terrace, **Kandleralm** promises an unforgettable stay.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, **Brixen im Thale** is the ideal base for discovering the magic of **Tirol**. From scenic hikes to charming villages like **Ellmau** and **Wildschönau**, adventure and tranquility await at every turn.

**Come and experience the warmth of the Alps at Berggasthof Kandleralm!**
